value.rationale: Five calibrated real coefficients are the sharp minimum for arbitrary planar ellipse tomography. The particular low-degree Fock vacuum row suffices despite lacking any radial quadratic moment, and positive boundary Gram gives an explicit local stability certificate. This addresses a natural time-frequency aperture identification problem across a five-parameter geometric family.
